I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47.

Pree posted Dock 23 in #central-team on Oct 14. Later that day she corrected it to Gate 47 because she'd read the wrong line. Both messages are in that channel, and Hollis is a member, so he can see where the answer comes from.
